3967.title: Layout characters bypass shortcut fallback
3967.rootCauseOneLine: Physical-key fallback is gated on Alt and omits punctuation, so Cyrillic event characters fail Latin shortcut comparisons.
3967.proposedFix: Extend physical-key fallback after deciding compatibility and conflict handling for saved non-Latin bindings.
3967.caveats: Shared-function reproduction repeated in two clean checkouts; no Windows UI or native-menu verification. Test and output are inline under the reports repository publication rules. No automatic PR because saved-binding compatibility requires a product decision.
